holders.name: Douglas E. Lytle
holders.notes: Official Town of Lusk mayor page, retrieved 2026-11-24, names Mayor Douglas E. Lytle (mayor@townofluskwy.gov) and still prints 'Elected: May, 2022' and 'Term: 4 years'. Official June 2, 2026 council minutes: 'The new council members (Ty Thompson, Chantry Filener, and Thomas Dooper) and the mayor (Douglas E. Lytle) were sworn in.' Official July 7, 2026 minutes still list Mayor Douglas Lytle, who called the meeting to order. Official August 4, September 1, October 6, and November 3, 2026 minutes were called to order and signed by Mayor Pro-Tempore Thomas Dooper, with Lytle not recorded present; no official resignation was found in those official minutes. Official term-end day after the June 2, 2026 swearing is not printed; a four-year mayoral term from that official swearing is taken through June 2030 (medium).

offices.note: Official Town of Lusk site is townofluskwy.gov (the older official townoflusk.org site is down). Official mayor page, retrieved 2026-11-24, names Mayor Douglas E. Lytle. Official June 2, 2026 minutes swear him in as mayor. Official July 7, 2026 minutes still list Mayor Douglas Lytle. Official August–November 2026 regular minutes were chaired and signed by Mayor Pro-Tempore Thomas Dooper, with Lytle not recorded present; no official resignation was found in those official minutes.

offices.note: Four-member council (official town code 2-5-100, printed on the official 2024 Town Election page: mayor plus four council persons). Official June 2, 2026 minutes swear in Thomas Dooper, Chantry Filener, and Ty Thompson. Official council page retrieved 2026-11-24 lists Dooper (Mayor Pro Tempore), Filener, and a Ty Thompson heading, and does not yet list Holmes.
